text:
ashley: FYI I found a nasty conversion/behavior combo on the new HF checkpoint when we enable int8. Symptoms: context corruption after ~1k tokens and stray </s> tokens in chat output. Suspect config.json fields not mapping cleanly to Redwood runtime.

sam: can you paste the head config? which fields looked off? :thinking_face: 

ashley: root config excerpts:
```json
"max_position_embeddings": 2048,
"num_key_value_heads": 16,
"num_attention_heads": 32,
"rope_scaling": { "factor": 1.5, "type": "linear" },
"sliding_window": 128
```
Problem: num_key_value_heads != num_attention_heads / 2 (works out here but different variants use alias names), sliding_window semantics differ from our sliding KV cache, and rope_scaling is HF-only knob that we don't translate into runtime interpolation properly.

julia: ugh yeah rope_scaling often breaks quantized runtimes if we don't rescale rotary embeddings in the kernel. Did you see mismatch in tokenizer special tokens too?

ashley: yes — tokenizer has a NUL style special token for system prompt boundary which got dropped into chat_template mapping. So chat templates + max_position_embeddings mismatch -> tokens pushed past 1024 and got truncated in weird ways after quant.

nora: quick repro steps you used? I can try locally on my GPU.

ashley: repro summary:
1) convert HF model with our hf-to-redwood script (master)
2) run int8 quant with quantize.py (per-measure)
3) run multi-turn chat with long system prompt + ~1.2k user history
Observations: early tokens ok, after ~1k generation coherence drops, then stray end tokens. Logs show KV cache shape (seq, heads_kv) mismatch warnings.

ryan: did conversion log any warnings about kv_head aliasing or max pos truncation? We added a new check in PR #412 but it's opt-in.

ashley: conversion output: 
```
WARN: config.num_key_value_heads (16) differs from num_attention_heads/num_kv_div (expected 16) -> ok
WARN: sliding_window field present, assumed legacy semantics; using default=false
INFO: rope_scaling present, storing as meta. NOT_APPLIED during compile.
```

ml-bot: automated eval (bench/seq-len-regression) flagged model: perplexity delta +2.1 on 1500-token eval set after quantization.

sam: proposal: conversion should canonicalize these fields into explicit runtime params: 
- kv_heads -> compute from num_attention_heads if missing or set alias mapping
- sliding_window -> map to "kv_cache_sliding" with semantics: window_size and stride, not a single int boolean
- rope_scaling -> bake into rotary scaling factors per layer (or emit fallback runtime interpolation table)
- max_position_embeddings -> ensure tokenizer and model configs aligned, and trim/raise a warning if tokenizer introduces extra special tokens that push effective context > max_pos

julia: +1. Also add a small unit: after conversion run a fast FP32 inference over dummy inputs at seq lengths [512,1024,1536] to detect early shape/overflow regressions. 

nora: I can take sliding_window mapping and tokenizer alignment. Will add a script to detect special token collisions with chat templates and compute effective_max_pos.

ashley: I'll draft a conversion patch to apply rope_scaling into a per-layer linear rescale table for the runtime and fallback to a runtime flag enable_rope_interpolation that will adjust kernels at load-time.

ops-bot: FYI created issue RED-759 for kv/head canonicalization and RED-760 for rope_scaling runtime flag.

ryan: let's also add a quick smoke test into model-onboarding CI: quantized smoke with seq=1200 should fail-fast if outputs diverge > threshold from fp32 baseline.

ashley: agreed. I'll open PRs for conversion changes + tests. tagging @sam @julia for review. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — please paste PR link once ready.

ml-bot: noted: schedule a bench run after PR merge to validate quality regression metrics.

ashley: thanks team, moving this to a short spike, will update here with PRs and repro artifacts.
